title: HEK293T Landing Pad Recombination Protocol with Fugene
author: Sarah Roelle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcdeis3e

steps.title: Plate cells with doxycycline media
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of culture medium containing doxycycline to achieve a final concentration of 2 µg/mL in each well of a 24‑well plate, then seed 120,000 HEK293T cells per well.

steps.title: Make Opti1 mixture
steps.instruction: In a sterile tube, combine 23.8 µL Opti‑MEM with 1 µL Fugene 6 (keep DNA volumes between 1.0–5.0 µL if possible); mix gently.

steps.title: Make Opti2 transfection mixture
steps.instruction: For a Bxb1‑containing sample, add 23 µL Opti‑MEM, then add the volume of Bxb1 expression plasmid that provides 16 ng DNA and the volume of attB plasmid that provides 238 ng DNA. For a no‑Bxb1 control, add 23 µL Opti‑MEM and the volume of attB plasmid that provides 254 ng DNA. Keep each plasmid volume between 1.0–5.0 µL if possible; mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate mixtures
steps.instruction: Allow the Opti1 and Opti2 (or Opti2‑noB) mixtures to sit at room temperature for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add transfection mixtures to wells
steps.instruction: Add the Opti1 mixture and the corresponding Opti2 (or Opti2‑noB) mixture dropwise to each well, distributing the solution throughout the well; then rock the plate back and forth to ensure even mixing.

steps.title: Supplement wells with media
steps.instruction: Add a minimum of 500 µL of fresh culture medium to each well after the transfection mixture has been added.

steps.title: Monitor and split cells
steps.instruction: Observe the cells daily; when confluency approaches 20 % or higher, split the cultures (commonly by transferring all cells into a 6‑well plate) according to standard HEK293T passaging procedures.

steps.title: Induce negative selection
steps.instruction: If the landing pad encodes iCasp9, add AP1903 to each well to reach a final concentration of 10 nM; monitor for cell death as early as 2 hours post‑addition and replace media to remove dying cells.

steps.title: Apply puromycin selection
steps.instruction: If the attB vector carries a puromycin resistance marker, add puromycin to a final concentration of 1 µg/mL; perform this positive selection only after the well has reached greater than 20 % confluency and after any negative selection has been completed.

steps.title: Run flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and run samples through a flow cytometer; include an untreated control well (no selection) to determine the percentage of reporter‑positive cells, then multiply that percentage by the total number of cells originally plated (e.g., 120,000 per well) to estimate the absolute number of recombined cells.
